name: Vegan Mac and Cheese
directions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil for the macaroni. Add generous amount of salt and cook 1 minute less than time indicated on box
Drain pasta and add in the butter
Peel carrot and potatoes and cut into small chunks
Add carrots, potatoes, and cashews into medium saucepan and cover with water until submerged. Bring to boil and boil for 15 minutes until the vegetables are soft. Drain and rest until cool
Make crispy topping while veg boils. Melt butter and mix all crispy topping ingredients and a pinch of salt until no clumps
Add all the remaining cheese sauce ingredients into a blender and boiled carrots and cashews
Blend on high until smooth and creamy. Then add potatoes and blend on low until fully combined and pureed. Adjust seasoning to taste
Add cheese sauce into the cooked macaroni. Fold until well incorporated
Add the incorporated macaroni into a prepared baking dish (~4.8 Q) and sprinkle crispy topping evenly on top
Bake for 20 minutes or until topping is golden brown. Once done, take out of the oven and cool for 10 to 20 minutes
